verdict.rationale: OpenTofu is an open-source, locally run infrastructure-as-code CLI. Nothing in the evidence shows it is a hosted service that collects or stores user data, so a training-data opt-out control is a category error for this kind of product. State encryption is a separate at-rest security feature and does not address AI training use, so it is not credited here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
